mapper.sql: FROM orders_normal_orders_items oi INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.company_id = oi.company_id WHERE o.order_status = 'DONE' AND o.order_class = 'normal' AND oi.auto_close_aftersales_time IS NOT NULL AND oi.auto_close_aftersales_time <= #{now} AND oi.aftersales_status IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE orders_normal_orders_items SET aftersales_status = 'CLOSED' WHERE id = #{id} AND aftersales_status IS NULL
